description: Updates YouTube broadcast settings (only when has linked YouTube channel using Oauth).

adFrequency.description: Mid-roll ad breaks. Partner Program channels only.

defaultLanguage.description: Language of the title, e.g. en, es-MX.

madeForKids.description: Required by YouTube before a stream can start. Ask the user, never assume.

recordFromStart.description: Keep the broadcast as a video after it ends.

retryMirror.description: Copy the stream's schedule onto YouTube again, e.g. after reconnecting the channel.

scheduleOnYoutubeWhenScheduled.description: Show the broadcast as upcoming on the channel as soon as the stream is scheduled.

thumbnailObjectID.description: An uploaded image, for thumbnailSource custom.

thumbnailSource.description: auto: a frame of the first video. custom: thumbnailObjectID. none: YouTube's own.

name: stream_update_youtube_broadcast_settings
title: Update YouTube broadcast settings
